name: Parallel Search MCP
summary: Free hosted MCP server from Parallel with web_search and web_fetch tools for agents; no account or API key needed to start.
description: Streamable HTTP endpoint. Anonymous free-tier searches run in `fast` mode; pass a Parallel API key as a Bearer token for production use, higher rate limits and configurable search behavior.

agent_access.notes: No auth for the free tier; optional API key via Authorization: Bearer.
